title: Questions 151–160 (Fragen 151–160)
tip: After each Check you get an English explanation and a short German note (Auf Deutsch).

exercises.title: Frage 151 · Block 7
exercises.prompt: Wer baute die Mauer in Berlin?
exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** die DDR

The **DDR government** built the Wall (13 August 1961), with Soviet blessing, but it was East Berlin's decision and East German soldiers who built it, to stop the hemorrhage of its own citizens westward (~3 million had fled).

The West didn't wall itself in; the Allies were surprised by the overnight operation. Note the direction: the Wall's guns pointed *inward*, a state imprisoning its own people. →Q188/189 for the year.

## Auf Deutsch

Die Mauer in Berlin baute 1961 die DDR, gegen die eigene Bevölkerung.

exercises.title: Frage 152 · Block 7
exercises.prompt: Wann waren die Nationalsozialisten mit Adolf Hitler in Deutschland an der Macht?
exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** 1933 bis 1945

**1933–1945**, twelve years that define German memory politics.

A is the early Weimar Republic; B stretches across the 1945 defeat (impossible); D is the *postwar* era. Anchor both ends: 30.01.1933 appointment (→Q156), 08.05.1945 capitulation (→Q153).

## Auf Deutsch

Die Nationalsozialisten waren 1933 bis 1945 an der Macht.

exercises.title: Frage 153 · Block 7

options.text: Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs in Europa
Beginn des Baus der Berliner Mauer

exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs in Europa

**08.05.1945**, unconditional German surrender; war over in Europe. Modern Germany calls it **Tag der Befreiung** (day of liberation, from its own regime), following President von Weizsäcker's landmark 1985 speech. That reframing, defeat as liberation, is core Erinnerungskultur and superb interview material.

Wall 1961, BRD 1949, WWI 1914, the distractors test whether your dates float or sit fixed.

## Auf Deutsch

Der 8. Mai 1945 ist das Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs in Europa.

exercises.title: Frage 154 · Block 7
exercises.prompt: Wann war der Zweite Weltkrieg zu Ende?
exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** 1945

1945 (in Europe: May 8; Japan: September). The wrong years are the block's other landmarks. Nazi takeover, double state founding, Wall. BAMF recycles the same four numbers as mutual distractors: **1933 · 1945 · 1949 · 1961**. Own all four and half this block solves itself.

## Auf Deutsch

Der Zweite Weltkrieg endete 1945.

exercises.title: Frage 155 · Block 7
exercises.prompt: In welchem Zeitraum herrschte in Deutschland der Nationalsozialismus?
exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** 1933–1945

→Q152 retested. The neighboring periods have names too: 1918–33 **Weimarer Republik** (first democracy), 1945–49 **Besatzungszeit** (occupation), 1949– **Bundesrepublik**. Knowing the sequence Weimar → NS → occupation → two Germanys → unity is the skeleton of the entire history section.

## Auf Deutsch

Der Nationalsozialismus herrschte 1933–1945.

exercises.title: Frage 156 · Block 7
exercises.prompt: In welchem Jahr wurde Hitler Reichskanzler?
exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** 1933

**30 January 1933**, appointed (not elected!) Reichskanzler by President Hindenburg, legally, within Weimar's rules; the dictatorship was then built *from inside* the system in months (Reichstag fire decree, Ermächtigungsgesetz).

1923 was his failed Munich putsch (jail, wrote *Mein Kampf*). The lesson the Grundgesetz drew: democracies can be murdered legally, hence eternity clause, constructive no-confidence, party bans (→Q12, Q20, Q127).

## Auf Deutsch

Hitler wurde 1933 Reichskanzler.

exercises.title: Frage 157 · Block 7
exercises.prompt: Die Nationalsozialisten mit Adolf Hitler errichteten 1933 in Deutschland …
exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** eine Diktatur

Within months: all other parties banned (→Q170), unions crushed, press centralized, political enemies in the first camps (Dachau opened March 1933). Everything a Rechtsstaat is (→Q3), inverted.

## Auf Deutsch

1933 errichteten die Nationalsozialisten eine Diktatur.

exercises.title: Frage 158 · Block 7
exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** Diktatur

→Q157. "Drittes Reich" was the Nazis' own propaganda term (after the Holy Roman and 1871 empires); historians use it in quotes. A **Räterepublik** (council republic, D) refers to the brief 1918/19 revolutionary experiments, obscure on purpose.

## Auf Deutsch

Das „Dritte Reich“ war eine Diktatur, keine Demokratie.

exercises.title: Frage 159 · Block 7
exercises.prompt: Was gab es in Deutschland nicht während der Zeit des Nationalsozialismus?
exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** freie Wahlen

Nicht-question: what did NOT exist = **free elections**. The regime held staged plebiscites with open ballots and 99% results, theater, not choice (compare the five Wahlgrundsätze, →Q122: every single one violated).

Censorship, arbitrary arrest, persecution of Jews, all defining realities. This question and Q30 are mirror images: what democracy has, dictatorship lacks, and vice versa.

## Auf Deutsch

In der NS-Zeit gab es keine freien Wahlen.

exercises.title: Frage 160 · Block 7
exercises.explanation:
**Correct answer:** der Zweite Weltkrieg

01.09.1939 (Germany invades Poland, the aggression is the point: the war began *from* Germany) to 1945. WWI: 1914–18; the Cold War (D) was the *non*-shooting 1947–89 standoff; Deutsch-Französischer Krieg: 1870/71.

## Auf Deutsch

Von 1939 bis 1945 dauerte der Zweite Weltkrieg.
